category_title: Students without academic skill deficits who engage in active/disruptive work avoidance
scenario_title: Independent reading with off-task and out-of-seat behavior
minimal_context: Martin is participating in independent reading at his desk in a second-grade classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent reading. Please sit at your desk and read your book quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns his body away from the assigned materials and stares at the back of the classroom.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Martin, you need to look at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans over to the next desk) Hey, what page are you on? Look at this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop talking and focus on your own reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets out of his seat and walks away from his desk, leaving his book behind to avoid the reading task.)

STUDENT: (Gets out of his seat and walks away from his desk, leaving his book behind to avoid the reading task.)
